subject: Re: Availability delta during peak - provisional credit & RCA next steps
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@stripepay.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: ops-team@stripepay.com
Date: 2027-12-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Service impact during peak (12/22 07:38-08:05 UTC) - credit request

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking a look. We saw a sharp increase of 500ms+ checkout latency and a 3.1% spike in 5xx responses between 07:38 and 08:05 UTC on 2027-12-22 that directly correlates with a failed campaign send and measurable revenue impact. Our SRE pulled the attached sample error rows and a short list of correlated user IDs so you can trace the traffic.

Can Redwood confirm the availability window and advise next steps for SLA credit? We also need an ETA for a postmortem for our SOC/finance team — they require the timeframe and the proposed remedy to reconcile our billing adjustments.

Attachments: error-samples-20271222.csv

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Platform Reliability, StripePay
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@stripepay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-12-22T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Service impact during peak (12/22 07:38-08:05 UTC) - credit request

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the samples and the clear timestamps. I’ve copied our SRE lead (Laura) and Billing (Ben) to pull telemetry and start an evidence bundle. Quick responses to help us speed this:

- Can you confirm whether the 07:38 timestamp is in UTC?
- Do you have a representative request ID or one affected customer token we should prioritize?

Initial plan from our side: we’ll validate availability against the global SLO windows, extract raw traces for the 07:30–08:10 UTC period, and produce a provisional credit calculation (prorated by impacted tokens/minute) while the RCA is being drafted. If we confirm an availability delta that qualifies, we can issue a provisional credit within 5 business days, pending final postmortem.

I’ll follow up with the telemetry bundle and a provisional calc.

Best,
Tessa
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-22T13:42:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: provisional credit calc + evidence pull for StripePay impact

Tessa / Ben —

SRE summary (preliminary): we see a routing misconfiguration on a subset of instances in us-west-2 that caused request queuing and elevated tail latency between 07:38:12 and 08:04:59 UTC. Error rate rose mostly for checkout POSTs due to upstream timeouts. Collected artifacts:

- Ingest traces: ingest-traces-20271222.zip
- Prefix/KV cache evictions log (snippet) included in the zip

Attached is a provisional credit sheet (provisional-credit-calc.xlsx). Calculation notes: determine total token-minutes impacted by multiplying peak request rate delta * average tokens/request * duration, then prorate against the monthly commitment for DEAL-9842. Using StripePay’s committed units and observed delta we get a provisional credit of 2.4% of the November invoice (rounded) — subject to final RCA and any overlap with scheduled maintenance.

Next steps:
- I’ll assemble the full trace bundle and highlight representative request IDs.
- Ben, once you sign off on the calc I’ll prepare the provisional credit note and the RC A draft for Elena.

Laura
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: provisional-credit-calc.xlsx, ingest-traces-20271222.zip)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@stripepay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-12-23T16:06:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Service impact during peak (12/22 07:38-08:05 UTC) - credit request

Elena —

Appreciate your patience. We’ve completed the initial evidence pull and a provisional calculation. Summary:

- Confirmed impacted window: 2027-12-22 07:38:12–08:04:59 UTC (routing/queuing on subset of US-WEST-2 pool).
- Provisional credit: equivalent to 2.4% of the affected billing period (see attached calc). This is being issued as a provisional credit pending the final RC A and verification that no overlapping scheduled maintenance applies.
- Postmortem ETA: draft RCA will be shared by 2027-12-28; final postmortem (including remediation plan and preventive actions) by 2028-01-04.

Attachments shared: ingest-traces-20271222.zip, rca-draft-20271223.pdf, provisional-credit-calc.xlsx

If StripePay needs the credit issued faster for accounting, let us know and Ben can expedite the credit memo. We’ll also include the representative request IDs and explain the root cause (routing misconfiguration causing queue growth) in the RCA.

Onward —
Tessa Morgan
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
